n: ScratchEd Embedding Scratch in US History and Geography
t: A 2009 unit outline that turns 5th grade map activities into Scratch challenges.
steps: Find the unit outline on the ScratchEd page.
Download the Word document and the .sb templates.
Ask IT for help with an old Scratch desktop version or a conversion.
Open the geographic terms template and test it.
Plan your own challenges for the explorers and colonies topics.
Decide how students will save their work.
